insight: Unifies Microsoft's earlier Semantic Kernel and AutoGen projects, which both entered maintenance mode as it superseded them.
name: Microsoft Agent Framework
tagline: Open SDK for production AI agents in .NET and Python.
description: Microsoft's multi-language framework for building, orchestrating, and operating AI agents and multi-agent workflows. It offers a consistent API across C#/.NET and Python with first-class support for both, plus built-in durability, restartability, observability, and human-in-the-loop control. Provider-flexible, so the underlying models can change without rewrites.

modelSupport.notes: Provider-flexible across OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and others.

edge: Microsoft-backed with first-class .NET and Python parity plus built-in durability, observability, and human-in-the-loop from a single vendor.
pros: Migration paths from SK and AutoGen
cons: Younger than the frameworks it replaces
